items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: That's Willie Humphrey, the old man.

ctx.x: They always have one clarinet. We'd have saxophone and things like that. You see Jungle Casualty? Old man Humphrey, and a couple of more. It was one of the best street parade clarinet players you've ever seen. That's Willie Humphrey, the old man.
See them people used to play the Little E-Fact clarinet. Can't find none there. Some of them used to play C clarinet.
